title: Metabolic reprogramming by histone deacetylase inhibition preferentially targets NRF2-activated tumors
model: Two KP and two KPK (Keap1-null, NRF2-active) mouse LUAD lines, chromatin-focused knockout library (611 genes)
contrast: Extra dropout in KPK vs KP lines, T1 (14 doublings) vs T0 paired by line and replicate (24 libraries)
paper_method: MAGeCK-MLE, ranked by beta difference (KPK - KP)
paper_calls: Class I HDACs (Hdac1, Hdac2, Hdac3) preferentially required in KPK cells
barcs_calls: 84 genes at FDR 0.10 (44 more depleted in KPK); too few controls (36) for a control null
verdict: BARCS calls all three class I HDACs as KPK-specific dependencies at FDR < 0.02, and its interaction ranking tracks the authors' MAGeCK-MLE beta difference closely (Spearman 0.94). It ranks Hdac1 above Hdac3, because Hdac3's KPK-specific difference is noisier across guides.
